verses.text: Ix yalanxi Jehová t'ayin a in Jeremías in tik:

Ochanh tek'tek' t'a spuertail in templo a in Jehová in tik, tzalan juntzanh lolonel tik t'a heb' anima: Masanil ex kajan ex t'a Judá, mach ex tzex och t'a jun puerta tik yik tzex och ejmelal t'a Jehová, scham wal eyab'an jun lolonel yik Jehová Yajal t'a Smasanil, haton ko Diosal: Tato ol he b'o he b'eyb'al yet' tas tze k'ulej, ol ex wak' kajnaj t'a sat lum tik.
Manh eyak'och he pensar t'a heb' tz'esani, heb' tz'alan icha tik: Kojtak wal to malaj tas ol onh ik'anok, yujto ayek' skajnub' Jehová t'a tik, haton wal stemplo tik, skomon chiej heb'.
Tato tze b'o he b'eyb'al yet' tas tze k'ulej, tato wach'nhej tzeyutej he b'a t'ayex junjun ex,

tato max eyixtej heb' ch'ok chonhab'il, heb' unin manhxa smam yet' heb' ix chamnakxo yetb'eyum ayek' t'a he kal, tato max he milcham heb' anima malaj smul, tato max ex och ejmelal t'a juntzanh komon Dios, juntzanh tz'ik'an he juwieli,
tato icha chi' tze k'ulej, ol ex wak'kan kajan t'a jun lum tik, haton lum wak'nakkan t'a heb' he mam eyicham t'a junelnhej.
Palta a ex tik, tzeyak'och juntzanh esal lolonel malaj yelk'och t'a he k'o'ol.
Tzex elk'ani, tzex mak'wicham anima, tze k'ulej ajmulal, tze lok in b'i t'a es, tze nhusan incienso t'a Baal, tzex och ejmelal t'a komon Dios to malaj eyalan heyik t'ay.
Slajwi chi' tzex ja pax t'a wichanh t'a in templo tik, tzeyalani: Malaj tas ol onh ik'anok, xe chi. Anhej yik tzex elb'ati tze b'eyb'alanxi juntzanh tas yajb'entak t'a yol in sat.
¿Tom tze na' to a in templo tik lajan yet' k'e'en nhak'e'en b'aj sk'ub'ej sb'a heb' elk'um? Ha in wal Jehová in swala' to swilnhej masanil juntzanh tze k'ulej tik.
Ixikek b'aj ek'nak chonhab' Silo b'aj ek'nak in kajnub', haton jun chi' in sik'nakel t'a sb'ab'elal b'aj in ch'oxnak in b'a. Hata' ol heyila' tas wutejnak in satanel yuj smul heb' he mam eyicham.
Ha in Jehová in swala' to ix he k'ulej juntzanh chukal tik, tzijtum el ix wal t'ayex to tzeyaktejkani, palta maj he k'anab'ajej. Ix ex wawtej, palta maj ex tak'woklaj t'ayin.
Yuj chi' icha wal wutejnak in kajnub' t'a Silo chi', icha chi' ol wutejkan in templo tik, haton jun wak'nak t'a heb' he mam eyicham yet' t'ayex tik, haton jun tzeyak'och yipok he k'ol tiknaik.
Ol ex wik'kanel t'a wichanh, icha wal ix aj wik'anel heb' eyetchonhab' t'a wichanh t'a yalanhtaxo, haton heb' yinhtilal Efraín, xchi Jehová, xa chi t'a heb'.
Ix yalanxi Jehová t'ayin icha tik: Ach Jeremías, manh ach lesalwok yuj jun chonhab' tik. Manh al t'ayin, manh ach tewok t'ayin yuj heb', yujto manh ol in tak'wok t'ayach.
¿Tom max il tastak sk'ulej heb' t'a juntzanh chonhab' t'a yol yik Judá yet' t'a yoltak calle t'a Jerusalén?

Ha heb' yuninal heb' sayankot te' k'atzitz, haxo heb' mamab'il tz'ak'anoch te' k'ak', haxo heb' ix nunab'il sb'o'an ixim k'oxox pan yik syak'an heb' silab'il t'a sdiosalil, jun skuchan ix yajalil satcha'anh. Stzuntzej wal kot yowal in k'ol heb' ayik syak'an wino heb' silab'il t'a komon Dios.
Ha in wal Jehová in swala' to manhok innhej tzin yixtej heb', palta munil syixtej pax sb'a heb' yak'an k'ixwelal sb'a.

Yuj chi', a in Jehová Yajal in swala' to ol wak'kot yowal in k'ol t'a yib'anh jun lugar tik: Haton t'a yib'anh heb' anima, t'a nok' nok' yet' te te' yet' t'a yib'anh masanil awb'en. Lajan wal wowal chi' icha junok te' k'ak' tz'eli, maxtzak yal-laj stupi, xchi Jehová.
Ha Jehová Yajal t'a Smasanil, haton sDiosal Israel, a tz'alan t'a schonhab' icha tik: Hak'ek he gana eyak'an he silab', nok' snhusjitz'aok, tze chi'an schib'ejal juntzanhxo nok' silab' chi'.
Palta ayik wik'annakelta heb' he mam eyicham t'a Egipto, malaj tas walnak t'a heb' yuj nok' silab' snhusji yet' ofrenda.

Ha tas in b'ab'laj alejnak t'a heb' to tzin sk'anab'ajej heb'. Tato icha chi', a in ton tzin och sDiosalok heb', haxo heb' tz'ochkan in chonhab'ok. Walannak to sk'anab'ajej heb' icha wal tas ix wala', yik wach'nhej tz'elk'och heb'.

Palta maj schalaj yab' heb', maj sk'anab'ajej heb'. Ha tas sk'ulejnak heb' to yak'nak pitb'okel spensar heb', sk'anab'ajannak schukal spensar heb'. Oktom swach' b'oejnak sb'eyb'al heb', palta to swach' juejnakel sb'a heb'.
Yiktax yelnakkot heb' he mam eyicham t'a Egipto masanto tiknaik, tzin cheknhejb'at heb' in chekab' yala'.
Palta a ex tik, max he k'anab'ajej, max he cha eyab' tas swala'. Te pit tzeyutej he b'a. Yelxo wal te chuk tzeyutej he b'a t'a yichanh heb' he mam eyicham chi'.
Ha hachxo tik ach Jeremías, al masanil juntzanh tik, wach'chom manh ol schalaj yab' heb' t'ayach. Alnhej, wach'chom manh ol tak'wok heb'.
Al t'a heb' icha tik: Ha ex wal tik junelnhej te pit ex, malaj he gana tzex kachji yuj Jehová ko Diosal. Manhxa mach yel syal t'a he kal, xa chi t'a heb'.
Ex aj Jerusalén, joxekel xil he jolom yuj kusk'olal, tzeyumaneli. Ixikek t'a lum tzalkixtak kuseltak yilji, tze b'itan b'it yik kusk'olal, yujto toxo ix ex waktejkan yuj yowal in k'o'ol, xchi Jehová.

Ix yalanxi Jehová icha tik: Ha heb' aj Judá, te chuk sk'ulej heb' t'a wichanh. Ha juntzanh skomon diosal heb' yajb'entak ix yak' wal och heb' t'a yol in templo. Icha chi' ix aj sjuwiel in templo chi' yuj heb'.
Ha t'a sch'olanil lum Ben-hinom, hata' ix sb'ok'e jun altar heb' yik Tofet b'aj snhustz'a yuninal heb' yet' yisil. Manhok in ix in chek sk'ulej heb', maj ek'paxlaj jab'ok t'a in pensar.

Yuj chi' a in wal Jehová in swala', ay jun pekti' to a jun ch'olan chi', manhxo ol skuch Tofet, ma sch'olanil lum Ben-hinom, palta ol skuchkan icha tik: Lum Sch'olanil yik heb' mak'b'ilchamok. Yujto manhxa b'aj syal smukji heb' chamnak, yuj chi' ha t'a lum Tofet chi' ol b'at juljokkan heb'.
Ha sniwanil heb' anima ayek' tiknaik t'a jun chonhab' tik, ol och schib'ejok nok' ostok yet' nok' chium nok' t'a kaltak te'. Manhxa mach ol xib'tan nok' t'a heb'.

Ol wak' satel heb' anima t'a juntzanh chonhab' yik Judá. Haxo t'a yoltak scalleal Jerusalén, manhxa b'it yik k'inh yet' yik tzalajk'olal. Manhxa pax b'it yik nupnajel ol ochok. Ichaxonhej tzinan lu'um ol ajkan jun chonhab' tik, xchi Jehová.
